description: Ministry of Trade Commerce Food Security and Co-operative Development - The Societies Ordinance No. 16 of 1981
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize purposes for specific societies and limit the application of the ordinance. This constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name and title is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
